title: InstarConfig
description: Settings read from an `instar.toml` project configuration.

aliases.description:
Require aliases mapped to paths relative to this configuration. Entries inherit by name.

Default: `unset`.

build.description:
Source builds, bundle output, runtime targets, compilation, and named build profiles.

Default: `unset`.

definitions.description:
External Luau definition files, resolved relative to this configuration.

Default: `unset`.

exclude.description:
Source exclusion patterns relative to this configuration. Explicit file inputs bypass selection; an empty list clears inherited patterns.

Default: `unset`.

format.description:
Formatter settings. Ancestor settings merge field by field; absent settings use their documented defaults.

Default: `unset`.

grafts.description:
Graft names mapped to manifest paths relative to this configuration. Entries inherit by name and run in name order.

Default: `unset`.

include.description:
Source selection patterns relative to this configuration. Explicit file inputs bypass selection; an empty list clears inherited patterns.

Default: `unset`.

lint.description:
Lint rules, groups, globals, and options. Settings inherit from ancestor configurations.

Default: `unset`.

mode.description:
Checking mode. Inherits from ancestor configurations; defaults to nonstrict. CLI mode and file directives take precedence.

Default: `unset`.

roblox.description:
Downloaded Roblox types, instance mappings, and analysis permissions.

Default: `unset`.

Binding.description: Declaration form for eligible require bindings.

oneOf.description: Keep the source declaration form.
Convert eligible bindings to const.
Convert eligible bindings to local.

blank_lines.description:
Remove or preserve one existing blank line at each block boundary. Interior statement gaps are retained independently.

Default: `"remove"`.

collapse.description:
Collapse eligible single-statement blocks: never, functions, conditionals, or always. Comments can prevent collapsing.

Default: `"never"`.

BuildConstant.description: Scalar value substituted for an unshadowed global read.

BuildProfile.description: Named overrides applied to the base build settings.

BuildSettings.description: Build inputs, outputs, transformations, and profile overrides.

constants.description:
Replace reads of these unshadowed global names with scalar constants. Assignments to constants are rejected.

Default: `{}`.

entry.description:
Bundle entry relative to the build configuration. Required for bundle output.

Default: `unset`.

external.description:
Exact require specifiers supplied by the deployment runtime rather than this build.

Default: `[]`.

inputs.description:
Input files and directories relative to the build configuration. Required for directory output.

Default: `[]`.

languages.description:
Input extensions mapped to configured compiling graft names. A leading dot is omitted.

Default: `{}`.

lower.description:
Remove type-only syntax, assertions, and const declarations while retaining Luau runtime syntax.

Default: `false`.

minify.description:
Remove comments and unnecessary whitespace. Literal contents and token boundaries are preserved.

Default: `false`.

output.description:
Output directory or bundle file relative to the build configuration. Required.

Default: `unset`.

profiles.description:
Named overrides for build configuration. Paths remain relative to this configuration.

Default: `{}`.

shape.description:
Directory output retains project-relative paths; bundle output follows the entry's dependencies.

Default: `"directory"`.

target.description:
Require output syntax. Unset uses Roblox strings when Roblox is enabled, otherwise relative paths.

Default: `unset`.

oneOf.description: Emit separate files using project-relative paths.
Combine reachable modules into a single bundle.

BuildTarget.description: Runtime representation of rewritten require targets.

oneOf.description: Relative filesystem paths.
Roblox string require paths.
Roblox instance expressions.
Give expanded arguments separate lines.
Keep a final table, function, or multiline string attached when possible.

chains.description:
Layout of repeated dot and colon calls.

Default: `{"minimum_calls":3,"style":"preserve"}`.

expand.description:
Expand argument lists when needed by width, always, or never voluntarily. Mandatory line breaks are retained.

Default: `"needed"`.

indentation.description:
Number of additional indentation levels for expanded arguments.

Default: `1`.

parentheses.description:
Always use parentheses, omit them for a sole string or table argument, omit either optional form, or preserve the input choice.

Default: `"always"`.

style.description:
One-per-line separates expanded arguments; hug-last keeps a final table, function, or multiline string attached to preceding arguments unless expansion is always. A sole string, table, or function remains attached in either style.

Default: `"one-per-line"`.

Chain.description: Line-break policy for repeated dot and colon calls.

oneOf.description: Retain ordinary call layout.
Keep the first call with its receiver.
Allow a line break before every call.

Chains.description: Style and count threshold for expanding call chains.

minimum_calls.description:
Force chain expansion at this many calls. Zero disables count-based expansion; width-based wrapping remains available.

Default: `3`.

style.description:
Preserve ordinary call layout; method keeps the first call with the receiver; full allows a break before every call. Both method and full handle dot and colon calls.

Default: `"preserve"`.

Collapse.description: Eligible single-statement blocks to collapse onto one line.

oneOf.description: Keep block bodies on separate lines.
Collapse eligible function bodies.
Collapse eligible conditional branches.
Collapse both eligible function bodies and conditional branches.

expand.description:
Expand conditional expressions when needed by width, always at the outermost level, or never voluntarily. Column-width wrapping still applies.

Default: `"never"`.

indentation.description:
Number of additional indentation levels for expanded conditional branches.

Default: `1`.

placement.description:
Same-line starts the expression after its binding or return; next-line moves an expanded sole expression to an indented line.

Default: `"same-line"`.

style.description:
Block places branch values on indented lines; leading places then and else before their values on indented lines.

Default: `"block"`.

width.description:
Flat expression width that triggers expansion when expand is needed or always.

Default: `60`.

oneOf.description: Expand only when required by the column width.
Expand outer conditional expressions regardless of width.
Expand expressions exceeding the configured conditional width.

ConditionalStyle.description: Placement of keywords in expanded conditional expressions.

oneOf.description: Put branch values on indented lines after their keywords.
Begin indented branch lines with then or else.

Constant.description: Treatment of table mutation when suggesting constant bindings.

mutated_tables_stay_local.description:
Keep local for bindings whose table fields are mutated.

Default: `false`.

Constants.description: Scope-aware conversion of local bindings to constants.

prefer_constant.description:
Convert eligible unreassigned local bindings to const using lexical scope analysis.

Default: `false`.

preserve_mutated_tables.description:
Keep bindings to mutated tables local when preferring constant bindings.

Default: `false`.

Declaration.description: Declaration form for eligible function definitions.

oneOf.description: Keep the source declaration form.
Use a local function declaration.
Use a constant function declaration.
Use a global function declaration.

additional.description:
Deprecated function names mapped to replacement descriptions.

Default: `{}`.

Endings.description: Line-ending sequence emitted by the formatter.

oneOf.description: Emit a line feed.
Emit a carriage return followed by a line feed.

Expansion.description: Voluntary expansion of lists across lines.

oneOf.description: Expand when the list exceeds the available width.
Expand eligible lists regardless of width.
Keep lists flat unless a mandatory break requires expansion.

Functions.description: Function parameter layout and declaration conversion.

binding.description:
Preserve function declarations or convert eligible declarations to local, const, or global forms.

Default: `"preserve"`.

parameters.description:
Layout of function declaration parameters.

Default: `{"expand":"needed","indentation":1}`.

Gaps.description: Treatment of existing blank lines at layout boundaries.

oneOf.description: Remove boundary blank lines.
Retain one existing boundary blank line.
Sort all adjacent imports together.
Separate alias, other, and relative paths into ordered groups.

Imports.description: Ordering, declaration conversion, and removal of require bindings.

binding.description:
Preserve require binding declarations or convert eligible bindings to const or local.

Default: `"preserve"`.

grouping.description:
Flat sorts imports together; by-kind groups alias paths, other paths, then relative paths, inserting blank lines between categories. Only applies when sorting.

Default: `"flat"`.

sort.description:
Sort eligible adjacent require bindings by module path.

Default: `false`.

unused.description:
Ignore unused require bindings, prefix their names with an underscore, or remove eligible declarations.

Default: `"ignore"`.

style.description:
Indent with tabs or spaces.

Default: `"tabs"`.

width.description:
Columns per indentation level, including the display width of a tab. Must be positive when formatting is enabled.

Default: `4`.

Indexer.description: Placement of table-type indexers when fields are sorted.

oneOf.description: Put indexers before named fields.
Put indexers after named fields.
Sort indexers alongside fields using an empty key.

Level.description: Reporting level assigned to a lint rule.

oneOf.description: Suppress the finding.
Report an informational finding.
Report a warning without failing the command.
Report an error that fails the command.

LintOptions.description: Options shared by configurable built-in lint rules.

deprecated_function.description:
Additional deprecated functions and replacements.

Default: `{"additional":{}}`.

restricted_global.description:
Restricted global names mapped to reasons.

Default: `{}`.

restricted_import.description:
Restricted module paths and reasons.

Default: `{"paths":{}}`.

unused_variable.description:
Shared options for unused bindings, functions, and imports.

Default: `{"ignore_pattern":"^_","loop_variables":false,"parameters":false}`.

LintSettings.description: Lint enablement, severity overrides, globals, and rule options.

enabled.description:
Enable linting. Unset enables linting.

Default: `unset`.

globals.description:
Additional global names available to this project.

Default: `[]`.

groups.description:
Group levels. Disabled-by-default rules require an individual rule override.

Default: `{}`.

rules.description:
Individual rule levels. Graft rules use graft/rule identifiers.

Default: `{}`.

LintUnused.description: Binding categories and names checked for unused declarations.

ignore_pattern.description:
Regular expression matching ignored binding names.

Default: `"^_"`.

oneOf.description: Check inferred and annotated types strictly.
Use Luau's permissive type-checking mode.
Skip type checking while retaining parsing and enabled lint checks.

Operators.description: Layout of union and intersection operators.

expand.description:
Expand unions and intersections when needed, always, or never voluntarily. Nested types and overload signatures remain grouped where possible.

Default: `"needed"`.

Options.description: Complete formatter settings with inherited project defaults.

bindings.description:
Scope-aware conversion of local bindings to constants.

Default: `{"prefer_constant":false,"preserve_mutated_tables":false}`.

blocks.description:
Statement block layout and existing blank lines.

Default: `{"blank_lines":"remove","collapse":"never"}`.

calls.description:
Argument parentheses, list layout, and repeated calls.

Default: `{"chains":{"minimum_calls":3,"style":"preserve"},"expand":"needed","indentation":1,"parentheses":"always","style":"one-per-line"}`.

column_width.description:
Target line width in columns. Must be positive when formatting is enabled. Unbreakable syntax may exceed it.

Default: `120`.

conditionals.description:
Layout of if-then-else expressions, not conditional statements.

Default: `{"expand":"never","indentation":1,"placement":"same-line","style":"block","width":60}`.

enabled.description:
Format source files and run formatting grafts.

Default: `true`.

exclude.description:
Exclude matching source paths unless included at format level. Patterns are relative to the declaring configuration. Explicit file inputs bypass selection. An empty list clears inherited patterns.

Default: `[]`.

expand_on_trailing_comma.description:
Expand table expressions whose source contains a trailing comma.

Default: `true`.

final_newline.description:
End nonempty formatted output with a newline.

Default: `true`.

functions.description:
Function parameter layout and declaration binding rewrites.

Default: `{"binding":"preserve","parameters":{"expand":"needed","indentation":1}}`.

imports.description:
Require binding ordering, grouping, conversion, and unused binding handling.

Default: `{"binding":"preserve","grouping":"flat","sort":false,"unused":"ignore"}`.

include.description:
Include matching source paths. Patterns are relative to the declaring configuration and override format exclusions. Explicit file inputs bypass selection. An empty list clears inherited patterns.

Default: `[]`.

indentation.description:
Indentation characters and columns per level.

Default: `{"style":"tabs","width":4}`.

leading_zero.description:
Add, strip, or preserve the zero before the decimal point in fractional numeric literals.

Default: `"add"`.

line_endings.description:
Unix emits line feeds; windows emits carriage return plus line feed.

Default: `"unix"`.

quotes.description:
Prefer-double and prefer-single choose the delimiter with fewer unescaped occurrences in the source, using the preference for ties. Double and single enforce a delimiter; preserve retains it. Long strings retain their delimiters.

Default: `"prefer-double"`.

semicolons.description:
Never emits statement semicolons only where required to preserve parsing; always emits them after eligible statements.

Default: `"never"`.

spacing.description:
Interior delimiter spaces and spacing before function parentheses.

Default: `{"braces":true,"brackets":false,"function_names":"never","parentheses":false}`.

tables.description:
Field ordering in table expressions.

Default: `{"order":"preserve"}`.

trailing_separator.description:
Emit a trailing separator in expanded tables and table types, using the configured table-type separator where applicable.

Default: `true`.

types.description:
Table-type fields and union and intersection layouts.

Default: `{"operators":{"expand":"needed"},"tables":{"blank_lines":"remove","enabled":true,"indexer":"first","order":"preserve","separator":"comma","width":60}}`.

oneOf.description: Retain the source order.
Sort shorter keys first, breaking ties alphabetically.
Sort longer keys first, breaking ties alphabetically.
Sort keys alphabetically.
Sort narrower formatted fields first, breaking ties alphabetically.
Sort wider formatted fields first, breaking ties alphabetically.

Parameters.description: Layout of function declaration parameter lists.

expand.description:
Expand declaration parameters when needed by width, always, or never voluntarily. Mandatory line breaks are retained.

Default: `"needed"`.

indentation.description:
Number of additional indentation levels for expanded declaration parameters.

Default: `1`.

oneOf.description: Parenthesize every argument list.
Omit parentheses around a sole string argument.
Omit parentheses around a sole table argument.
Omit parentheses around either optional argument form.
Retain the source choice where syntax permits.

Placement.description: Placement of an expanded expression after its binding or return.

oneOf.description: Start on the same line as the preceding syntax.
Start a sole expanded expression on an indented line.

Quotes.description: Delimiter selection for short string literals.

oneOf.description: Minimize escapes, preferring double quotes on ties.
Minimize escapes, preferring single quotes on ties.
Use double quotes.
Use single quotes.
Retain the original delimiter.

Restricted.description: Modules whose imports should produce a lint finding.

paths.description:
Exact module paths mapped to restriction reasons.

Default: `{}`.

RobloxConfig.description: Opt-in Roblox environment and generated-asset selection.

cache.description:
Roblox cache directory, relative to this configuration. Defaults to the platform cache directory under instar/roblox.

Default: `unset`.

level.description:
Roblox API security level. Inherits from ancestor configurations; defaults to `PluginSecurity`.

Default: `unset`.

project.description:
Rojo project path relative to this configuration.

Default: `unset`.

revision.description:
Full commit hash of the generated Roblox assets. Unset checks for updates every 24 hours.

Default: `unset`.

sourcemap.description:
Existing instance-to-source mapping path relative to this configuration.

Default: `unset`.

RobloxLevel.description: Permission level used to select accessible Roblox API members.

oneOf.description: Members available to ordinary experience scripts.
Members additionally available to local user scripts.
Members additionally available to Studio plugins.
Members additionally available to Roblox internal scripts.
Emit semicolons only where required to preserve parsing.
Terminate every eligible statement with a semicolon.

Separation.description: Spaces between function names and opening parentheses.

oneOf.description: Keep names adjacent to parentheses.
Insert a space in function declarations only.
Insert a space in function calls only.
Insert a space in declarations and calls.
Separate members with commas.
Separate members with semicolons.

Sorting.description: Ordering of fields in table expressions.

order.description:
Preserve field order, sort alphabetically, by key length, or by formatted field width. Length and width orders use alphabetical tie-breaking. Comment-bearing tables retain their order.

Default: `"preserve"`.

braces.description:
Add interior spaces to nonempty braces.

Default: `true`.

brackets.description:
Add interior spaces to nonempty brackets.

Default: `false`.

function_names.description:
Add a space before function parentheses: never, definitions, calls, or always.

Default: `"never"`.

parentheses.description:
Add interior spaces to nonempty parentheses.

Default: `false`.

Tables.description: Layout and ordering of table-type members.

blank_lines.description:
Remove or preserve existing blank lines between members without inserting new gaps.

Default: `"remove"`.

enabled.description:
Format table-type layouts. When false, multiline table types retain their source layout and single-line table types stay flat.

Default: `true`.

indexer.description:
Place indexers first, last, or among sorted fields. Used only when order changes; sorted indexers use an empty key.

Default: `"first"`.

order.description:
Preserve field order, sort alphabetically, by key length, or by formatted field width. Length and width orders use alphabetical tie-breaking. Comments prevent sorting.

Default: `"preserve"`.

separator.description:
Separate table-type members with a comma or semicolon.

Default: `"comma"`.

width.description:
Maximum flat table-type width before expansion, also constrained by `column_width`.

Default: `60`.

TypeExpansion.description: Expansion policy for union and intersection members.

oneOf.description: Expand when members exceed the available width.
Expand eligible members regardless of width.
Avoid voluntary expansion while retaining required breaks.

operators.description:
Layout of union and intersection members.

Default: `{"expand":"needed"}`.

tables.description:
Layout and ordering of fields in table types.

Default: `{"blank_lines":"remove","enabled":true,"indexer":"first","order":"preserve","separator":"comma","width":60}`.

oneOf.description: Leave unused bindings unchanged.
Prefix unused binding names with an underscore.
Remove eligible unused declarations.

Whitespace.description: Characters used for each indentation level.

oneOf.description: Indent with tab characters.
Indent with space characters.

Zero.description: Leading-zero treatment for fractional numeric literals.

oneOf.description: Insert a zero before a leading decimal point.
Remove a zero before a leading decimal point.
Retain the source spelling.
